description.content: Operations for querying Azure Monitor metrics

item.name: Azure Monitor List metrics at subscription scope

request.name: Azure Monitor List metrics at subscription scope

description.content: Lists the metric values for a subscription. The $filter parameter is used to reduce the set of metric data returned. Only some dimensions are available for subscriptions.

query.description: (Required) Client API version.
The region where the metrics you want reside.
The timespan of the query in ISO 8601 duration format (startDateTime_ISO/endDateTime_ISO).
The interval (window size) of the query in ISO 8601 duration format.
The names of the metrics (comma-separated) to retrieve. Maximum of 20.
The list of aggregation types (comma-separated) to retrieve.
The $filter is used to reduce the set of metric data returned. Uses OData filter expressions.
The maximum number of records to retrieve. Defaults to 10.
The aggregation to use for sorting results and the direction of the sort.
Reduces the set of data collected. Data or Metadata.
Metric namespace to query metric definitions for.
If set to true, the time grain is automatically adjusted based on the timespan.
If set to false, invalid filter parameter values will be ignored.
Dimension name(s) to rollup results by.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the target subscription.

response.name: Successful request to get the list of metric values.
